finalized_content: Camelot-OS Enterprise vMAX Production Architecture. Unified Fleet Supervisor orchestrates Bifrost Board (:5173), Sir Sonus (:7680), Multivoice Router (:8090), and Wasmtime (:8400) under 103MB total RAM footprint. Excalibur Mobile Bridge streams Samsung Galaxy S26 Ultra (100.106.246.126) at 120Hz with native touch controls. Sir Sonus executes full-duplex 16kHz PCM audio with sub-100ms VAD and sub-60ms barge-in. Arthurian Omni-Forge executes 7-stage state machine (Intent, Spec, Plan, DAG, Sandbox, Verification, Receipt) under 512MB RAM cap with Z3 convexity theorem proof. Bifrost Board provides live GUI with interactive SVG DAG and real-time provenance streaming. Tailscale WireGuard mesh verifies all 8 nodes with sub-second RTT latencies and Global Law 03 memory compliance.
